title: YOU CALL FOR EXTRACTION
why: His v9.59 note: the game says call FOR extraction. Since v22.47 the hint under the last-seconds alert, standing in a ring with nothing called, dropped the word for again, the shorter verb phrase he had asked to be gone, and two old checks of that rule were red. It now reads Hold [E] to call for extraction.
now: Standing in a ring, the hint reads Hold E to call for extraction again.

edits.anchor: if(no.d<no.z.r) return 'Hold '+_K+' to call extraction';   // v22.xx (tr3fixc): the shooter voice
edits.replacement: if(no.d<no.z.r) return 'Hold '+_K+' to call for extraction';   // v22.xx (tr3fixc): the shooter voice   // v22.xx (tr9fixa): his v9.59 verb, you call FOR extraction
